title: Selected Topics in Asian American Studies; Introduction to Health and Mental Health Policy Issues (AANHPI Communities)
description: This hybrid class will provide an introduction to key areas of public health impacting Asian American, Native Hawaiian, and Pacific Islander communities, to include: data and research; barriers to accessing care; infrastructure for advocacy; reproductive healthcare equity; and other emergent structural issues. Lecture, outside experts from the field, and field work and observation comprise the critical learning modes.
